label: S07 Marina Bay Resorts (Dubai, collides with Al Noor)

details.title: Master Services Agreement
details.courts_or_seat: courts of Pune have exclusive jurisdiction

governing_law_source.quote: 8.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts of Pune have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote:
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of 1 November 2026 (the "Effective Date") between:

**Marina Bay Resorts LLC**, a company incorporated in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, having its registered office at Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai ("Marina Bay"); and

**AtliQ Technologies Private Limited**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: 2.1 Marina Bay shall pay USD 150,000 in total, within thirty (30) days of receipt of each invoice.

details.services_summary: Revenue-management analytics and guest analytics services, including a booking-engine module for four resorts in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

liability_cap.basis: limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim
liability_cap.quote: 6.1 Each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Vendor shall not provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the UAE for six months after term.
restrictive_covenants.restricted_activity: provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the United Arab Emirates
restrictive_covenants.quote: 3.1 For six (6) months after the end of the term, Vendor shall not provide revenue-management services to any other hotel group in the United Arab Emirates.

titles: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform

all_findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
all_findings.why: Same industry, region, activity, and non-compete still active until 2029.
all_findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
all_findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
all_findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

all_findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
all_findings.why: Exclusivity may restrict partnering with competing cloud analytics vendors in UAE, unclear if booking engine uses such vendor.
all_findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
all_findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
all_findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.
